purpose: Independent synthetic release set; not a production population estimate

protocol.negative_citations: Required when the case asks to disclose conflicting evidence; abstention and citations can both be required.
protocol.grading: Judge the requested core facts and every claim actually made. Additional expected context is not required. Verify citations against the full frozen source, including superseded claims; a correct quotation alone does not establish semantic support.
protocol.label_uncertainty: Municipal conflicting-count and retirement-date cases expect explicit unresolved conflict. Publish disagreements with this rubric alongside outcomes; never change v1 labels after observing results.
